headerDisplay:
AlorAir Lite HomeKit Dehumidifier Platform
Control AlorAir-Lite Smart WiFi LGR Dehumidifiers in Apple HomeKit via Cloud API or Zero-Cloud Local TCP — with built-in Wi-Fi recovery tools.
footerDisplay: Tip: If your AlorAir mobile app stopped working, enable the Built-in Wi-Fi & Setup Wizard below (or run `npx homebridge-alorair-lite-setup`) to provision 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi via Web Bluetooth / SoftAP and run 100% locally via DNS override (`online-app.toovem.com`).

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Display name used in Homebridge logs (and default accessory name in Local TCP mode).

transport.title: Connection Mode

oneOf.title: AlorAir-Lite Cloud (Auto-discovers owned dehumidifiers via email & password)
Zero-Cloud Local TCP Listener (Works without AlorAir app/account via LAN DNS redirect)

transport.description: Choose Cloud API polling or direct LAN TCP control (default port 6100).

email.title: AlorAir-Lite Account Email
email.description: Email address used to sign in to the AlorAir-Lite mobile app.

allowInsecureHttp.title: Acknowledge Unencrypted Vendor Cloud HTTP
allowInsecureHttp.description: The official AlorAir-Lite backend (http://online-app1.toovem.com:8081) only speaks plaintext HTTP with RSA-encoded login.

mac.title: Device Wi-Fi MAC Address (Optional)
mac.placeholder: Leave blank to auto-discover, or e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF
mac.description: Optional 12-hex-digit Wi-Fi MAC to target/pin one specific dehumidifier. Leave blank to auto-discover all owned cloud devices or auto-learn on Local TCP.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Cloud Poll Interval (Seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Interval between cloud telemetry polls (default: 30 seconds).

listenHost.title: Local TCP Bind IPv4 Address
listenHost.description: Local interface IPv4 address for Homebridge to listen on (0.0.0.0 or concrete host LAN IP).

listenPort.title: Local TCP Listening Port
listenPort.description: TCP port the dehumidifier initiates connections to (6100 for AlorAir-Lite / Storm LGR, 6200 for Sentinel).

allowedClientIp.title: Allowed Dehumidifier Source IPv4 (Optional Hardening)
allowedClientIp.description: Optional DHCP-reserved IPv4 address of your dehumidifier so all other LAN hosts are rejected.

controllerProfile.title: Local Controller Protocol Profile
controllerProfile.description: Native TCP status frame layout expected by the local server.

allowLocalPowerOn.title: Allow Local TCP Power-On Commands
allowLocalPowerOn.description: Permits HomeKit to turn the dehumidifier ON over Local TCP (3-minute compressor restart protection still applies).

allowExperimentalLocalCommands.title: Enable Experimental Local Purge & Locate Switches
allowExperimentalLocalCommands.description: Exposes Purge (0x22) and Locate (0x27) over Local TCP.

enforceCompressorRestartDelay.title: Enforce 3-Minute Compressor Restart Protection
enforceCompressorRestartDelay.description: Requires at least 180 seconds off before sending a Power ON command.

autoPowerOnWhenSettingHumidity.title: Auto Power-On When Adjusting Humidity Slider
autoPowerOnWhenSettingHumidity.description: Automatically powers the dehumidifier on before applying a new target RH% if you move the Apple Home slider while the unit is off.

exposeInletTemperature.title: Expose Intake Temperature Sensor
exposeInletTemperature.description: Links an Intake Temperature Sensor directly to the Dehumidifier accessory in Apple Home.

exposeContinuousSwitch.title: Expose Continuous Mode ('CO') Switch
exposeContinuousSwitch.description: Exposes a dedicated HomeKit switch to toggle Continuous ('CO') mode vs. Auto humidistat mode.

exposePurgeSwitch.title: Expose Purge Condensate Pump Switch
exposePurgeSwitch.description: Exposes a HomeKit switch to trigger a condensate drain pump-out cycle.

exposeLocateSwitch.title: Expose Audible Locate Switch
exposeLocateSwitch.description: Exposes a HomeKit switch to toggle the dehumidifier's locate alarm.

exposeProblemSensor.title: Expose Fault / Problem Alert Contact Sensor
exposeProblemSensor.description: Exposes a Contact Sensor that opens on hardware error codes (E1, L0, HI, E5, E4, E3, E7) for iOS push notifications.

exposeDrainingSensor.title: Expose Draining Occupancy Sensor
exposeDrainingSensor.description: Exposes an Occupancy Sensor that activates whenever the condensate pump is actively draining.

exposeOutletSensors.title: Expose Outlet Temperature & Humidity Sensors
exposeOutletSensors.description: Exposes separate HomeKit sensors for exhaust/outlet temperature and relative humidity.

lowFilterThreshold.title: Filter Change Alert Threshold (%)
lowFilterThreshold.description: Remaining filter life percentage at or below which HomeKit raises a Change Filter alert.

enableSetupPortal.title: Enable Built-In Wi-Fi Provisioning & Setup Web Portal
enableSetupPortal.description: Starts a local browser wizard (default http://127.0.0.1:8589) for BLE/SoftAP Wi-Fi provisioning and live diagnostics.

setupPortalHost.title: Setup Portal Bind Host
setupPortalHost.description: Bind address for the Setup Portal (use 0.0.0.0 to reach from another LAN device; set a Setup Token if binding to 0.0.0.0).

setupPortalPort.title: Setup Portal Port
setupPortalPort.description: HTTP port for the Setup Web Portal.

setupPortalToken.title: Setup Portal Access Token (Optional)
setupPortalToken.description: Optional secret token (?token=...) required by Setup Portal API endpoints.

debugLogging.title: Verbose Protocol & Frame Logging
debugLogging.description: Logs redacted cloud polls and native TCP frame summaries at info level.
